40 weeks and 3 days = 40*7 + 3 = 283 days.  
Subtract 283 days from 1436-08-18.  
1436 is a leap year (divisible by 4).  
283 days before 08-18:  
Back to 07-31 is 18 days (Aug 18 → Jul 31).  
Remaining 283 - 18 = 265 days earlier.  
July has 31 days, June 30, May 31, April 30, March 31, February 29 (leap year), January 31.  
From July 31 back:  
June 30 → 265 - 31 = 234  
May 31 → 234 - 30 = 204  
April 30 → 204 - 31 = 173  
March 31 → 173 - 30 = 143  
February 29 → 143 - 31 = 112  
January 31 → 112 - 29 = 83 days left to go into previous year.  
83 days before Jan 1, 1436 = 1435-12-31 minus (83-1) days = 1435-10-09.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1435-10-09
